text: This build is for on-device testing. Everyone taking part must update to it. Event codes are handled differently now, so a mix of old and new builds will treat the same typed code as two different events and will not sense each other. Event codes are no longer case-sensitive and surrounding spaces are ignored: ETHTokyo and ethtokyo are the same event. The recording screen now shows a line reading "Diagnostics: N identified · N unidentified". It is a temporary investigation aid, not a count of mutual confirmations. After starting a recording with four or more people, please tell us how those two numbers moved. If the identified count stays flat, whether the unidentified count is rising tells us which cause we are looking at.
